name: References Resource
description: GitHub plumbing names or depends on a resource on the grid — a region string in a workflow, a hosted-zone name, a distribution id: whatever a link rule can match exactly. The target is intentionally a wildcard — GitHub configuration can name a resource in any system TAP models (an AWS region or hosted zone today, a GCP or Azure resource, a future software_package), so the target side is not enumerable from HERE: the set is whatever OTHER plugins have landed on the grid, and closing it in this file would mean editing github_core every time a sibling plugin adds a resource type. Precise about what the constraint does and does not say: the target side permits any NODE TYPE, not a "resource" category — TAP has no resource-category axis for a constraint to key on, so "resource" here is the relation's SEMANTICS, enforced where semantics belong (at emission), not by validate_edge(). Which concrete types actually link is decided at enrichment time by `github_grid_link_manifest`, whose exact-match-only, one-unambiguous-candidate policy is the conservative half of this relation and the right place for it. Does not claim deployment, ownership, or runtime control. Derived link — not hotlink-backed. Deliberately carries NO default `github.observation`: its sources span both observation layers (a workflow is a declaration, a run/job is an execution), so the layer is a property of the source endpoint, not of the edge type. The enrichment pass sets it per emitted edge from the source model's own default (req-github-core-dimensions-6).

link_rule.description: Derived-link provenance: the name of the grid-link manifest rule that emitted this edge (WHICH rule matched). Same shape as identity_core's TRUSTS_ISSUER — the enrichment engine's uniform provenance pair.

matched_value.description: Derived-link provenance: the exact value the rule matched on — WHAT the derivation keyed on.
